title: Audit of pcell-mwall-b42 metabolic (SIBEDH): all six replicate on fresh seeds 5-6 and at 1.5x resolution, and H passes a matched neutral-trait twin; but every mature death is a never-divided founder, most genealogy 'deaths' are remnant double counts, and E is by construction (cells live partly on an in-cell feed, yet survive small on imported substrate)
summary: Construction: read world.py line by line (identical to the parent claim's). Particles duplicate with c S (1-K) phi and die at a constant dK, independent of the yield trait y. Every particle draws the same substrate whatever its y (yeff=1). y only scales link production, which tilts the Allen-Cahn cell. The fixed-yield screens show division needs y above its start value. M is made by the catalyst from substrate and pushed to the wall by a drift up grad 4phi(1-phi), but 98% of it is made inside the cells' reach (phi>0.05). The substrate feed F(1-S) also acts inside cells and supplies 45% of their substrate influx. Replication, labkit re-runs on seeds 5 and 6 (rerun/) and on seed 7 at 1.5x resolution (rerun_res15/, scale=1.5, 192^2): persistent splits 17/13/14, max generation 4/3/4, merges 0-1, M rim/core 4.24/4.10/4.23. Mean y rises 1.00 -> 1.15/1.14/1.14 while the inert marker z ends at 0.99/0.99/0.96 (yz_trajectories.png). Deciding control for H: a neutral-trait twin matched to the evolved mean (ytrait=2, y0=1.13; every particle acts with 1.13, the trait is inherited and mutates without effect) on seeds 5 and 6 gives 8/4 persistent splits, 0/0 mature deaths and split percentiles of 0.52 in y. In the claimed world, dying mature cells sit at y percentile 0.007/0.025 against 0.60/0.59 for z. Flaws: (1) by the genealogy's definition, 11 of 17 (seed 5) and 18 of 25 (seed 6) deaths are double counts, where small remnants (20-30 particles) flicker across the 20-particle cell threshold. (2) All 13 mature deaths (6 + 7) are founder cells present since t~500 that never divided. No cell born by division died in 100000 t on either seed. Selection runs through non-dividing founders whose y drifts down to ~0.8, plus more division in high-y lineages. E: the feed-cut fork from the saved t=60000 states replicates (cells 27->0 and 29->0 within 250-500 t; fork_feed.png). A feed kept only inside the cells kills all of them. A feed kept only outside the cells keeps 11/15 small walled cells alive to t=70000 on substrate imported across the wall (S inside 0.27, bath 0.91; feedout_snaps.png).

verdicts.limitation: H rests on deaths of non-dividing founders only (13/13 mature deaths, both seeds) and on more division in high-y lineages. No born cell died within 100000 t. The genealogy's death count is inflated 2-4x by remnants crossing the 20-particle threshold (mature.py removes them). The trait is continuous and capped at 1.2 (mutations clip). The matched neutral twin divides less (8/4 vs 17/13 splits), so its baseline is close to but not identical with the selecting arm. E is by construction: links and particles decay and are built only from substrate, and 45% of the cells' substrate comes from the feed term inside the cells. The feed-outside-only control shows they can also live, smaller, on imported substrate. Two fresh seeds plus one resolution seed.
